desc: The VFA method involves at least two spoiled gradient echo (SPGR) of steady-state free precession (SSFP) images acquired at different flip angles. Depending on the provided metadata fields and the sequence type, data may be eligible for DESPOT1, DESPOT2 and their variants ([Deoni et al. 2005](https://doi.org/10.1002/mrm.20314)). Exactly one of: .nii.gz or .nii; .ome.zarr must be present.

# neuro/anat/vfa

DRAFT — generated from BIDS v1.11.2 by aimport/tools/draft_datatypes.py; check the brainlife registry for an existing datatype before registering.

Uses BIDS as the datatype: files are named as in BIDS, BIDS datatype `anat`, suffix `VFA`.

Source: BIDS specification v1.11.2, raw data, `anat/*_VFA`.

Exactly one of: .nii.gz or .nii; .ome.zarr must be present (alternative data formats, none is marked required).

The JSON sidecar is required (the schema requires metadata fields in it).
